rows.en: (Next class is physics, huh......)

Ugh... I was working on it last night
and never put it in my bag...
rows.notes: Male scene. Player realises the physics homework is still at home.

rows.en:
\p-kun,
what's wrong? Holding your head like that...

Claire-senpai... The thing is...
I left my physics assignment at home...

Silly... You went to all the trouble of doing it,
but it's no use if you forget it.
I have nothing to say for myself...

Physics, right...? I think I've got mine in my locker.
Wait right here a sec.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Claire means her own old assignment (next row: 'my old one').

rows.en:
Here. It's my old one, but if you copy
this part, you should be fine, right?
I wrote some notes in it, but don't mind them.
Th-thank you so much!
rows.notes: x7: also thanks for praise in scd_com_207/611/722; kept generic.

rows.en:
Oh, and as thanks, you owe me
a cafe latte at Silver Moon, okay?
O-okay, got it!
rows.notes: x6: also answers Klan in nml_kln_020 and scd_com_104; kept generic.

rows.en: (...Claire-senpai has pretty handwriting too~)

Ugh... I was working on it last night
and never put it in my bag~...

\p-chan,
what's wrong? Holding your head like that...
Waaah...
There, there, don't cry...
(...Claire-senpai's handwriting is pretty too~)
(Lunch break at last~ I'm starving...)

\p-kun,
what's wrong? You look kind of down.

I skipped breakfast this morning,
so I'm starving...
Is it really okay for me to have this?
rows.notes: Shared male/female. In the male script it also appears once right after c16139, before anything is offered (script order or an unused branch); the line is written for its normal place after Claire offers the bread.

rows.en: My, what a loud rumble.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. The player's stomach growls.

rows.en: Well then, I'll give you this.
Oh, it's bread...

It's a chocolate cornet.
It's sweet and really tasty, you know.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. choko korone: horn-shaped pastry filled with chocolate cream.

rows.en:
I've still got three more, so it's fine.
See you, then.
(Claire-senpai looks like a goddess to me...)

\p-chan,
what's wrong? You look kind of down.
Ahaha... How embarrassing...
Oh, it's bread...
...Is it really okay for me to have this?

(Classes are over, so maybe I'll stop
somewhere on the way home?)

Oh, \p-kun.
Heading home now?
Go straight home, no detours, okay?
Aww~
Hehehe, just kidding.
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Claire's laugh as in earlier slices.

rows.en:
Are you stopping somewhere on the way home
too, Senpai?
I'm planning to have tea with Yuu.
With Akimizu? You two sure are close.
Jealous?
W-Well... I mean... yeah...

Well then, Yuu's waiting for me,
so I'll get going.

(Maybe I'll grab a coffee or something
before heading home too.)

Oh, \p-chan.
Heading home now?
Aww~!
You two really are close, aren't you?

(Maybe I'll grab a coffee or something
before heading home too.)

(Phew~ Getting out in nature like this
once in a while isn't bad.)
Oh? If it isn't \p-kun.

Oh, Claire-senpai!
What are you doing in a place like this?
I thought I'd read a book outside for a bit.

Oh, really?
...Huh? Claire-senpai,
there's something on your shoulder.
My shoulder? What is it...?
Ah, looks like it's a bug.
A-A bug......
KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!

(I never thought Claire-senpai would scream
like that. She really can't stand bugs.)
rows.notes: x3: the player's inner monologue (female wording). In both variants it also sits mid-scene under Claire's name plate, right after her scream (likely a script slip); written as the player's monologue, gender-neutral, so it reads the same in all three places.

rows.en:
Listen. Don't you dare tell anyone
that I screamed like that.

As long as you understand.
W-Well, see you.

(Who'd have thought Claire-senpai would scream
like that? She really can't stand bugs, huh.)

(Phew~ Getting out in nature like this
once in a while isn't bad at all.)
Oh? If it isn't \p-chan.
I thought I'd read a book outside for a bit, you see.

uncertain: c16140: also appears in the male script right after the player says he skipped breakfast, before Claire offers anything; written for its normal place.
c16176: player monologue that also appears under Claire's name plate mid-scene in both variants; kept as the player's monologue, gender-neutral.
